_comment: Fixed PatchTST settings (no hyper-parameter search; nothing here is tuned on test data). Edit values here or pass --patchtst-config <file> to scripts/train_patchtst.py. 'horizons' = forecast lengths in days (7 is the priority and mirrors the LSTM; 30 / 90 reuse the same network with a longer head). context_length = days of history fed to the model; patches of patch_len days are taken every 'stride' days. NOTE: every input AND target day of a training/evaluation window must be a real (non-interpolated) observation, so a longer context_length leaves fewer usable windows.
